title: P0.29: Test Governance Observability and ControlMaster Test State
description: SelfAuditService._build_cross_source_truth() hardcoded tests_observed=false. ControlMasterState.current_tests_state existed but was never populated from real pytest results. Agents ran tests via audit_tools.run_pytest() but the organism had no canonical TestEvidence structure linking results to pending tasks.
reason: No persistence layer existed between audit_tools.run_pytest() and the metacognitive services (SelfAuditService, ControlMaster, PortableContextService). Tests ran but evidence was ephemeral — never persisted, never read by cross-source truth, never exported in portable context.
next_action: Run focused tests to confirm all five integration points work: persist, read, render, export, no-startup-auto-run.
resume_hint: P0.29 code complete: TestEvidence model in domain/models.py, audit_tools.run_pytest() persists evidence when persist_evidence=True, SelfAuditService reads latest evidence and flips tests_observed, ControlMaster renders current_tests_state via existing markdown path, PortableContextService exports compact test_evidence section.

metadata.root_cause: Gap: audit_tools.run_pytest() returned results but never persisted them. SelfAuditService._build_cross_source_truth() hardcoded tests_observed=false. ControlMasterState.current_tests_state was a dict field but never populated from real pytest output. PortableContextService had no test evidence section.

evidence.gap: No mechanism to read persisted test results

evidence.event: ControlMasterState.current_tests_state exists as dict but unpopulated
evidence.gap: No data source feeding test results into control master state

evidence.event: audit_tools.run_pytest() returns results but does not persist them
evidence.gap: Ephemeral results lost after MCP call completes

fixes_applied.task_1: Added TestEvidence compact model to domain/models.py: evidence_id, command, suite, keyword, passed/failed/errors, duration_s, returncode, timed_out, timestamp, linked_pending_task, changed_files, metadata.
fixes_applied.task_2: audit_tools.run_pytest() gains persist_evidence, linked_pending_task, changed_files params. _persist_test_evidence() writes compact JSON to data/evolution/test_evidence/latest.json. load_latest_test_evidence() reads and validates freshness (max 86400s).
fixes_applied.task_3: SelfAuditService._build_cross_source_truth() calls _load_latest_test_evidence() and sets tests_observed dynamically. Adds test_evidence_summary dict when evidence exists.
fixes_applied.task_4: ControlMasterState.current_tests_state already rendered by render_state_markdown(). Data populated when TestEvidence is read by consuming services.
fixes_applied.task_5: PortableContextService._test_evidence_section() exports compact test summary (health, passed, failed, errors, suite, timestamp) without logs or PII.
